text:
Maya (Marketing): Hey team — draft of the product launch blog is up: https://gist.github.com/rw-inference/launch-draft-05
Maya (Marketing): Three quick asks: 1) sign-off on the benchmark & cost numbers in the 'Benchmarks' section, 2) approve hero quote from Alex (CTO) below the fold, 3) confirm webinar CTA + HubSpot routing. Target publish Tue 04/14 9am PT. Need legal ok by EOD tomorrow.
Rui (SEO): skimmed — headline suggestion: "Shipping predictable, low-cost LLM inference for product teams" (shorter). Can we add a one-line TL;DR above the fold for SEO/og:title?
Sam (Growth): CTA / HubSpot: current funnel is webinar -> registration form -> nurture flow "launch-webinar-2026". I'll map the UTM and hubspot form IDs once final copy + speaker list are locked. Who's the primary speaker?
Olivia (Product): Benchmarks: we're showing P95 latency and per-token cost vs baseline. I think we should avoid absolute competitor names. Also change "4x cheaper" to "reduces per-token cost by up to 4x in our tests" — keeps claim but sets scope.
Jonah (Legal): Need the underlying test artifacts (scripts, dataset, raw CSVs) and a brief methodology blurb before I can ok the benchmarks. Also please remove any direct competitor logos or claims that imply we did head-to-head on customer workloads. If you must compare, use "our internal tests" phrasing.
Maya (Marketing): Copying the bench links here: s3://redwood-inference/pubs/launch/benchmarks/ (public-read link in doc). Methodology blurb is in the doc under "Bench methodology". I'll replace competitor mentions with the internal-tests phrasing. Will upload raw CSVs now.
Marvin (Ops): CSVs uploaded: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-inference/launch/benchmarks/raw-results-2026-03-20.csv. Test command used: ```python run_eval.py --model candidate --seq 1024 --dataset webeval --reps 10 --capture_latency``` (also in the doc footnote)
Olivia (Product): Thanks Marvin. I still want the P50/P95 numbers called out in the blog — P95 for latency is the critical stat for production. Can we list both with the baseline column named "common open baseline" (non-branded)?
Sam (Growth): For webinar speaker: Alex (CTO) + Priya (Customer) panel confirmed. Landing page URL we're routing to will be /events/launch-apr14. Sam: I'll set the HubSpot form id to `hs_form_launch_0426` and route leads to cadence "launch-attendees".
Rui (SEO): For OG and hero meta, short TL;DR suggestion: "High-throughput LLM inference with predictable costs and enterprise controls." Keeps keyword density without being spammy.
Jonah (Legal): I reviewed the methodology. Two small asks: 1) add a one-sentence limitation: "Results reflect internal workloads and may vary on customer data"; 2) remove the percentile ranges in the hero claim (keep them in the Bench section). After that I'm good to provide sign-off.
Maya (Marketing): Will add the limitation sentence and move percentile callouts down. Also swapping hero quote to this variant (Alex): "Our focus is making inference predictable and affordable at scale — so engineering teams can ship faster." — ok to use that copy?
Jonah (Legal): That quote is fine.
Sam (Growth): Quick check — embargo window? We plan to notify early access customers 04/13 10am PT and open public on 04/14 9am PT. Does that align with docs + webinar timing?
Olivia (Product): Webinar is 04/15 10am PT, so public post before webinar works. Make sure registration routing is live by EOD Tue.
Maya (Marketing): All right — I'll: 1) update hero + limitation, 2) remove competitor mentions, 3) link raw CSVs and methodology, 4) add OG TL;DR, 5) add HubSpot form id (Sam) and schedule publish for 04/14 9am PT with embargo. Will ping Legal once updated.
Sam (Growth): 👍 I'll queue the HubSpot form and UTM mapping after the final copy.
Marvin (Ops): small note — the CSV link is public-read; if Legal wants, I can create an anonymized artifact link.
Jonah (Legal): Please anonymize the CSVs (remove hostnames/ids) before we attach to the public blog. Otherwise good.
Maya (Marketing): Noted — Marvin, can you provide anonymized files? I'll then push the updated draft and re-request sign-off.
Marvin (Ops): done — anonymized CSV: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-inference/launch/benchmarks/raw-results-2026-03-20-anon.csv
Maya (Marketing): OK I'm updating the doc now. When I finish I'll drop the new link here and tag for final sign-off. Thanks everyone :rocket:
Sam (Growth): Approved pending final doc (quick thumbs).
Olivia (Product): Approved for technical accuracy once the wording tweaks are in.
Jonah (Legal): Tentatively approved pending anonymized artifacts (received) — will give final OK after I see the updated limitation sentence.
Maya (Marketing): Copy updated and limitation sentence added. New draft: https://gist.github.com/rw-inference/launch-draft-05-v2
Maya (Marketing): Tagging for final approvals — please reply with a quick ok so I can go to schedule. Deadline: EOD tomorrow.
Sam (Growth): ok
Olivia (Product): ok
Jonah (Legal): ok
Maya (Marketing): scheduled publish + HubSpot routing will be set after EOD approval. Thank you! :tada:
